messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we're cutting tomorrow. Can everyone please sanity-check their changelog bullets and PR bodies for the release notes merge gate? We're enforcing the changelog linter on merge so entries need: `Component`, `Summary` (one short sentence), `Why` (single short phrase), and `PR`.

Maya (PM): Example we want copied into PR body or a top-level comment before merge:
```
- Component: serving/runtime
- Summary: tighten KV-cache eviction to reduce cold-start latency
- Why: improves tail latency for chat workloads
- PR: #2139
```

Alex (Eng): Got it — I'll sweep `frontend` and `api` folders. Quick Q: are we standardizing on slash-separated components like `serving/runtime` vs `serving-runtime`? I can bulk-fix if we pick one.

Jorge (Eng): Use slash-separated, matches the release tooling mapping. If someone already used `- Component: misc` don't block — we can normalize in the entry before merge.

Samira (SRE): I have two entries queued (PRs #2145, #2152). Draft bullets:
```
- Component: serving
- Summary: reduce per-token compute cost via smarter batching
- Why: lower unit cost for short requests
- PR: #2145

- Component: infra/observability
- Summary: fix changelog-lint crash on empty entries
- Why: prevents CI false-negatives
- PR: #2152
```

Alex (Eng): I like the wording for #2145 — small tweak: change "reduce per-token compute cost" -> "reduce per-token compute" (shorter).

Maya (PM): Perfect. Two process notes:
1) Run `tools/changelog-lint --fix` locally before pushing the final commit.
2) We'll gate merges on the linter passing; any PR still failing the linter after 10:30 PT gets deferred to the next cut.

release-bot: :alarm_clock: Release cutoff in 3h (11:00 PT). Missing changelog entries detected in PRs: #2145, #2152 — please update.

Jorge (Eng): I'll do a quick copy-edit and add the slash-component to #2145 and #2152. @Samira can you paste the final bullets into the PR description so the linter picks them up?

Samira (SRE): Done — added the exact bullet blocks and ran the linter locally. Both PRs now pass `tools/changelog-lint --fix`.

Alex (Eng): I'll review and merge by 9:30 PT (before the gate). If anything blocks, I'll flag it here.

Maya (PM): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. :rocket: If anyone needs help with the linter errors paste output here and I'll pair on fixes.
